headline: Kazakhstan copper ore output declines 5.2% in first ten months of 2026
summary: Kazakhstan produced 128.7 million tons of copper ore between January and October 2026, marking a 5.2% contraction from the 135.82 million tons mined during the same period in 2025.
why: Kazakhstan is a major global supplier of metals and industrial ores, with extraction statistics providing key signals for regional mining output and raw material supplies.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: A 5.2% decrease in Kazakh extraction curbs regional ore feedstock supplies for smelting.
